_readme: FBS conference names per season, spelled exactly as CFBD /teams/fbs gives them. validate.py fails on any team whose conference is not listed, so a CFBD rename or a typo (which would silently create a one-team conference, crown it a champion and change the bracket) stops the pipeline instead. Add the new season's list each August, after checking realignment; the first week file of the season is also compared with nothing else, so check it by hand.
